versions.content: Within SoAd_TcpIpEvent() with Event set to TCPIP_TCP_CLOSED or TCPIP_TCP_RESET, SoAd shall (1) remove the assignment of the TcpIp socket identified by SocketId from the related socket connection and (2) close the socket connection if it is in SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE (i.e. perform the specified closing actions with the exception of closing related TcpIp socket).
